result.topic_en: A short trigonometric manipulation factoring sin(b+c) − cos A sin(b+c) as (1 − cos A) sin(b+c), followed by the analogous expression sin(b−c) + sin(b−c) cos A.

methods.what: Factoring out a common sine factor: sin(b+c) − cos A·sin(b+c) = (1 − cos A)·sin(b+c)
Analogous expression with b−c, of the form sin(b−c)(1 + cos A) (not factored on the page)
